explanation: Holst based the suite on astrology, which is why Earth has no movement. Mars marches in an unusual five beats to the bar, and Jupiter is 'the Bringer of Jollity'.

claims.text: In Holst's The Planets, the movement Mars is subtitled the Bringer of War.
In The Planets, Saturn is subtitled the Bringer of Old Age, Jupiter the Bringer of Jollity and Uranus the Magician.
Holst drew on the astrological character of the planets, and The Planets has no movement for Earth.
Mars, the Bringer of War is written mainly in five beats to the bar.
